reuse.why: Uses the db.first query helper and the existing per-provider link functions' parameters, adding one guard helper; it does not reuse the link.ts module that already holds shared linking helpers (findOrCreateBank), but there is no existing guard to reuse.

duplication.why: The rule lives in one helper; each of the five provider link functions adds an identical three-argument call, with the provider string repeated as a literal next to the existing literal it writes into account_sync_source.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers that call it; link.ts, which already holds the shared linking helper findOrCreateBank, would be an equally or slightly more natural home.

scope.why: Only the guard and its five call sites; nothing unrelated is touched.

maintainability.why: Simple and readable, and placed before any side effect so nothing changes on refusal; the weakness is that a sixth provider must remember to call the guard because the five near-identical link functions were not consolidated, and no test is added.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link paths call the new guard; no existing abstraction is circumvented

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the five call sites only pass their own provider id and account id

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts defines the 'already linked' rule (not tombstoned, same sync source and account_id, excluding the account being re-linked) and every provider's link function calls it
